items.verbatim: NOVEL INJECTABLE IMPLANTS FOR LONG-TERM LOCAL CONTROLLED RELEASE OF THERAPEUTIC MONOCLONAL ANTIBODIES - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT DELIVERY OF MONOCLONAL ANTIBODY (MAB) THERAPEUTICS TO HARD-TO-REACH AREAS OF THE BODY SUCH AS THE EYE, BRAIN, JOINT AND TUMOR TISSUES SUFFER FROM LOW DRUG CONCENTRATIONS A
